show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/9kaAMP
show.description: Piyush lives as a humble tailor while secretly being the billionaire owner of Tantra, sacrificing his wealth so his wife Vaani can succeed on her own. But Vaani humiliates him, cheats with her boss Raghav, and chases luxury and status. When tycoon Meher Mittal offers Vaani 300 crores for Piyush, she shockingly agrees and divorces him. Unaware that he is actually a billionaire, Vaani celebrates her deal until the truth emerges, leading to a downfall and a reckoning between greed and true love
